assets.desc: Extract and redraw ONLY this SAME shell-less orange hermit crab, facing RIGHT, isolated. Preserve his two large cream eyes on tall orange stalks, friendly small smile, TWO broad orange pincers with readable dark splits, thin orange legs, and soft curled salmon abdomen at LEFT. NO HARD SHELL. Keep exactly this appealing silhouette, broad head and solid continuous limbs, not spindly. Pose standing relaxed, feet level at bottom. Design for native 64x64 with 4-8 pixel wide eyes. Body and eyes on right, abdomen on left so a shell layer can fit left half.
